The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an [[Terminid]] Structure and Optional Objective for Terminid [[Missions]], in which the goal is to destroy a '''Stalker Lair.''' 
== Stalker Nests ==
[[File:Termind_City_Stalker_Lair.png|thumb|left|x200px|alt=| A Stalker Nest structure within the limits of a [[Colonies|Colony]]]]
Stalker Nests are a unique variant of [[Terminids|Terminid]] [[Bug Hole]].  While Helldivers are nearby, the Stalker Nests will regularly spawn the unique [[Stalker|Stalker]] enemy, a large, durable, heavy hitting Terminid with the ability to cloak.

As Stalkers are some of the deadlier Terminid enemies, closing the nests is a top priority.  However, the Stalker Lair Bug Holes can be destroyed in the same manner as ordinary Bug Holes, via explosives with a [[Demolition]] force of 20 (if a grenade is tossed inside) or any weapon with a demolition force of 40 or higher such as the [[GP-20 Ultimatum]].

{{Clear}}

== Objective Steps ==
* Destroy Stalker Lair
** There are 1-2 unique [[Bug Hole]] structures around the Stalker Nest.  They can be destroyed in the same manner as any other bug hole. 
* Reward: {{Currency|Requisition Slips|200}} & {{Currency|Experience|50}}

== Tactical Information ==
* Stalker holes can only be destroyed in two ways:
** Damaging the inside of the bug hole:
*** With a minimum demolition force of '''20''', which requires an '''explosive''' damage type.
** Damaging the outside of the bug hole:
*** With a demolition force of '''40''' or greater.
**** A single well placed [[TED-63 Dynamite]] grenade can destroy 2 holes.
* Helldivers should immediately destroy these Lairs, as Stalkers are one of the most dangerous [[Enemies|enemy]] types.
* Stalkers Lairs ''can'' also spawn small Terminids such as [[Scavenger|Scavengers]].
* Helldivers can easily locate Stalker Lairs by searching in the direction Stalkers are coming from, and looking for the orange glow of the bug holes.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Mission]] exclusive to [[Terminid]] [[Mega Cities]], which tasks Helldivers with destroying Terminid-infested skyscrapers within the Mega City.

== Objective Steps ==
=== Destroy Infested Tower ===
* This building has been overrun by Terminids and is now a [[Shrieker]] breeding ground.
** Helldivers must make their way to the marked Infested Tower and detonate a [[Hellbomb]] in its vicinity.

== Tactical Information ==

* The tops of the towers are often wider than their base, creating a significant overhang. Helldivers should take care when calling in a [[NUX-223 Hellbomb]] to ensure the hellpod does not get stuck on the tower when called in.
* While possessing significantly more health than a regular [[Shrieker Nest]], like all Terminid structures they have almost no armour and can be destroyed via any source of sustained damage from range.  They require a demo force of 50 to destroy outright.
** The [[EXO-45 Patriot Exosuit|Patriot]] and [[EXO-49 Emancipator Exosuit|Emancipator]] Exo-suits are ideal for this, although doing so will deplete their ammo reserves.
** The [[TD-220 Bastion MK XVI]] can destroy a single tower with either 4 shots, or 3 shots with the main gun and ~66 shots from the coaxial HMG.
** The [[M-1000 Maxigun]] has excellent sustained-fire capability against the Terminid structures, and is perhaps the best support weapon to bring down a tower quickly, ammo notwithstanding.
* When using the allocated NUX-223 Hellbomb to destroy the tower, be wary of any nearby [[Civilian|Civilians]] and [[SEAF Trooper|SEAF Troopers]], as their lack of situational awareness means they do not have the sense to avoid its massive blast.

== Trivia ==
*This mission contains the 80 available common samples starting from {{Difficulty|8}} to {{Difficulty|10}}, making it the only mission in the game to have the highest number of available common samples at that difficulty range.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Optional Objectives|Optional Objective]] that can appear on [[Automatons|Automaton]] controlled planets. Helldivers must destroy the Bio-Processors in order to complete the objective. It is located within an Automaton outpost and is often guarded by several Automaton units along with at least 1 [[Automaton Fabricator|Fabricator]].

== Objective Steps ==
* Destroy Bio-Processors
** Helldivers must destroy the Bio-Processors by any means necessary.

== Anatomy ==
{{Anatomy Table|
  {{Anatomy Row
    | part_name = Main
    | health = 5,000
    | av = 1
	| front_image = Bio-Processor.png
    | durability = 0%
    | percent_to_main = -
    | bleed = None
    | fatal = Yes
    | exdr = 0%
	| df= 40
  }}
| df = yes
}}

== Tactical Information ==
*As the Bio-Processors are completely unarmored, they are vulnerable to all Helldiver [[Weapons|weaponry]], including basic small arms fire.
* Confrontation with the Automaton Outpost can be easily avoided if a Helldiver is able to throw either high-damaging or demo force '''40''' [[Stratagems]] near the Bio-Processors, such as an [[Eagle Airstrike]].
* Similarly to other Optional Objectives that require Helldivers to destroy a structure, a [[NUX-223 Hellbomb|Hellbomb]] stratagem is provided to Helldivers when in close proximity to the Bio-Processors.
** While this method allows Helldivers to destroy the Bio-Processors without using any of their own munitions or Stratagems, it takes substantially longer to call in and arm the Hellbomb than if a Helldiver were to use other means of destruction.
* The layout of some bases can cause Bio-Processors to be sufficiently far away from each other that a single [[NUX-223 Hellbomb|Hellbomb]] cannot destroy them all, and cannot guarantee that the [[Orbital 120mm HE Barrage]] or [[Orbital 380mm HE Barrage]] will get them all. However the [[Orbital Laser]] will destroy them instantly and will track across the location to clear the objective, making it an effective solution if thrown close enough.
* 2 [[G-123 Thermite]] grenades will destroy a Bio-Processor, but only if they are thrown from close enough for the entire burn duration to apply to the structure, as the explosion only deals 2000 damage but can deal up to 2975 with the burn damage included.
Some demolition force 40 or higher options to destroy the bio-processors are as follows:
* [[Hellpod]] impacts are demolition force 40, which can destroy Bio-Processors, which is easy to achieve by throwing a Stratagem Ball (of something that comes in a Hellpod) in the gap between the two parts of a Bio-Processor, such as the provided Hellbomb Stratagem.
* Bio-Processors can also be destroyed with a single charge from the [[B/MD C4 Pack]], one shot from the [[EAT-411 Leveller]] or [[GP-20 Ultimatum]], or a single [[TED-63 Dynamite]] / [[G-48 Giga Grenade]].

Automaton Megafactory.title: Automaton Megafactory
Automaton Megafactory.text:
{{DisambigMsg|the Automaton Megafactories|the planet regions system|Regions}} {{Infobox Biome | biome=Automaton Megafactory | landscape= Megafactory Landscape Header.png | caption_landscape= | internal_name = no_name | archetype = Megastructure | subvariant = Urban Megastructures }} '''Megafactories''' are a type of megastructure, unique to [[Regions]] that are found on some planets. They are exclusively found on planets {{Automaton}} [[Automaton]] control, and produce the {{Cyborg Legion}} [[Cyborg Legion]]. == Overview == Megafactories, unlike Super Earth [[Metropolis]]es, do not cover the entire mission area. They leave a section (about 20-30% of the mission area) as the original planet's biome. These exterior portions usually contain the [[Extraction Zone]], and have a chance to spawn a handful of [[Automaton Outpost|Outposts]] and the occasional [[Optional Objectives|Optional Objective]], such as [[Upload Escape Pod Data|Upload Escape Pod Data.]] The terrain inside the Megafactories also remains relatively as it was, excluding mountains, large rock formations, and any kind of ravine. Inside the Megafactories stand tall, brutalist industrial buildings and machinery which occasionally have entry points, allowing both Helldivers and Automaton units to walk through them. Enemy [[Automaton Outpost|Outposts]] are constantly found here alongside enemy [[Optional Objectives]]. Monuments to the {{Cyborg Legion}} [[Cyborg Legion]] can also be found. The Automaton/Cyborg language is printed on most of the large factory buildings. Smaller prints, such as signs, display sentences ''(for translations see this page's gallery, or [[Automatons#Propaganda]])''. Larger prints, either on the sides of buildings or along pipes, display numbers. Between the Megafactory and the normal rural area stands a large, thick wall, separating them from each other with only a few access points, marked by icons on the map: * '''Culverts:''' Occasionally along the wall, the terrain will suddenly dip lower to reveal a large culvert with a broken grate. * '''Broken Walls:''' Some segments of the wall are destroyed, creating an opening into the Megafactory. * '''Gates:''' Massive gates are commonly found across the wall. Though they are closed from the start, they can be destroyed by dealing enough damage to them. ** Automaton units can also open and close the gate itself when they get close. File:MegafactoryGate.png|Map icon for a gate. File:MegafactoryExit.png|Map icon for a culvert or broken wall. == Gates == {{Anatomy Table| {{Anatomy Row | part_name = Gate | health = 6,000 | av = 4 | front_image = Anatomy Placeholder.png | side_image = | durability = 800% | percent_to_main = - | bleed = None | fatal = Yes | exdr = 0% | df = 40 }} |df= yes }} == Environmental Hazards == Outside the Megafactory wall, a planet may retain its biome's environmental hazards; for those, see the planet's biome page. This section is about hazards found in every Megafactory regardless of biome. * Large concrete cutouts full of [[Lava]] can be found across the surface. Stepping on them will deal damage and set the Helldiver on {{Damage|Fire}}. * Occasional spills of {{Damage|Acid}} can be found on the ground. Stepping on them will deal damage over time. * Tar slicks occasionally cover the floor near structures, particularly around Lava pools. Stepping on them slows down Helldivers and enemies. * Ventilation systems that release steam can be found across most buildings. Staying near them upon steam release will deal minor damage and knock Helldiver down. == Tactical Information == * Due to the limited entrances to the Megafactory, caution must be taken to ensure Helldivers are able to escape outside of them if the number of enemies starts overrunning their position. ** These entrances are relatively small, making them excellent chokepoints to eliminate enemies. Be aware that heavier enemies ([[Factory Strider]]s, [[Vox Engine]]s, etc) are able to pass through them as well. * Due to the relatively open nature of the terrain, especially compared to Metropolises, Helldivers must be aware of their surroundings or risk being flanked by enemies. ** These are even more dangerous with close combat enemies, such as Agitators, Berserkers, and Radicals. * The use of offensive stratagems is highly advised, though the increased presence of Anti-Air defenses means that Eagle Stratagems may be affected. Helldivers are advised to seek and destroy them whenever possible, even if they do not use Eagle Stratagems. * Gate entrances can either be destroyed or opened by Automatons. A slow, but simple way to open them is to fire into the air and bait them into opening it. ** Gates can also be destroyed with force using [[Demolition]] '''40''' [[Throwable|Throwables]] like the [[G-48 Giga Grenade]] or [[Stratagems]] such as an [[Eagle Airstrike]]. ** Finding an alternative entrance/exit (through a culvert or a broken wall) is more advisable and efficient. ==Trivia== *Megafactory Gates are the only entities in the game to have a durability value higher than 100%. **Due to this, weapons with a durable damage ratio of '''87.50% or lower''' deal '''zero''' '''damage''' to the gate. Weapons with a durable damage ratio of '''100%''' do '''full damage''' and weapons with a durable damage ratio '''higher than 100%''' deal '''bonus damage'''. *The track: [[Rise of the Cyborgs]], the theme of the {{Cyborg Legion}} [[Cyborg Legion]], will always play in Megafactory regardless if the Cyborg Legion is present or not. == Gallery == === Exterior === Cyberstan Megafactory Entrance Sewer.png|A culvert with a broken grate, one of the entry points into a Megafactory Cyberstan Megafactory Entrance Door.png| A closed gate, one of the entry points into a Megafactory Cyberstan Megafactory Entrance Broken Wall.png|A broken section of the outer wall, yet another entry point into a Megafactory Zzaniah Prime Megafactory Outside Wall Day.png|The outer wall of an [[Desert Dunes]] Megafactory during the day Zzaniah Prime Megafactory Outside Wall Night.png|The outer wall of an Desert Dunes Megafactory at night Charbal-VII Megafactory Outside Wall Day.png|The outer wall of an [[Acidic Badlands]] Megafactory during the day Charbal-VII Megafactory Outside Wall Night.png|The outer wall of an Acidic Badlands Megafactory at night Marfark Megafactory Outside Wall Day.png|The outer wall of an [[Icy Glaciers]] Megafactory during the day Marfark Megafactory Outside Wall Night.png|The outer wall of an Icy Glaciers Megafactory at night Marfark_Megafactory.png|A Helldiver overlooking a Megafactory on a Icy Glaciers planet. The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an Optional Objective contained within an Automaton Outpost. For as long as it is standing, it disables the use of any [[Eagle|Eagle Stratagems]] for Helldivers within 150m. To complete the Objective, Helldivers must destroy the Anti-Air Emplacements. It will always have [[Samples]] around it.

== Objective Steps ==
* Destroy Automaton Anti-Air Emplacements.
** Helldivers are permitted to call down a [[NUX-223 Hellbomb]] to destroy the AA-emplacements.
** Alternatively any [[Weapon]] with {{Armor|3|AP}} penetration or above are able to destroy the vents of the emplacements while any {{Armor|4|AP}} penetrative weaponry or [[Stratagems]] can destroy the {{PAGENAME}} to any part of the defense.
* Reward: {{Currency|Requisition|200}} & {{Currency|Experience|50}}.

== Tactical Information ==
* When a Helldiver is within 150m of an {{PAGENAME}}, all [[Eagle|Eagles]] become unusable. Their call-in sequences will be replaced by a message reading "Obstructed by Anti-Air".
* {{PAGENAME}}s will shoot upwards periodically, hinting towards their location.
* The majority of the {{PAGENAME}} is covered in {{Armor|4|AV}} armor, while having a {{Armor|3|AV}} weakspot on the back, so any {{Armor|4|AP}} armor-penetrating weapon such as the [[AC-8 Autocannon]] and [[LAS-98 Laser Cannon]] can destroy them from range at any angle without having to call down a [[NUX-223 Hellbomb]].
** Any anti-tank weapon can 1-shot the emplacements.
** The [[RS-422 Railgun]] requires an 80% charge shot to destroy.
** The [[PLAS-45 Epoch]] is a 1 shot with an uncharged shot.
* Weapons with {{Armor|3|AV}} penetration can still kill a {{PAGENAME}} from range. However, because they can only damage them from the back, a Helldiver will have to circle around to the correct position or wait for them to turn in a favorable direction.
** Oddly enough, AA Emplacements will rotate and "target" all Guard Dogs so stowing your Guard Dog by pressing the "Use Backpack Function" button ('''PC''' default press '''5''', '''PlayStation''' default press '''D-Pad Down''') is recommended to prevent aggro and make flanking the Emplacement easier. 
** Weapons that only have {{Armor|4|AV}} penetration should still try to target the heatsinks because of the damage reduction incurred against equal armor. This is especially true for weapons that also inflict shrapnel damage, as shrapnel is only {{Armor|3|AP}} penetrating.
* {{PAGENAME}}s can also be destroyed by any of the offensive [[Stratagems]] (excluding [[Eagle|Eagles]]), [[Emplacement Stratagems]], and the [[MD-17 Anti-Tank Mines]] if using handheld weapons aren't a viable option or simply to save ammunition.
*Damaging [[Grenade|Grenades]] that have {{Armor|4|AV}} penetration or above can destroy {{PAGENAME}}s.
** [[Thermite|G-123 Thermite]] can 1-shot an {{PAGENAME}} if it sticks.
** The [[G-12 High Explosive]] can also 1-shot {{PAGENAME}} but it needs to detonate close to the structure, usually by cooking the grenade to airburst it near the emplacement. The [[TED-63 Dynamite]] is more flexible due to higher explosion damage and larger blast radius, making it even capable of destroying two emplacements at once.
*Helldivers should be careful calling in an [[Eagle]] near the edge of the {{PAGENAME}}. If [[Eagle 1]] enters the AA's coverage she will be shot at and '''ALL''' Eagle stratagems will be put on cooldown, as if the [[Eagle Rearm]] stratagem was used, while repairs to the craft are made.
** The crafts called in from the [[Democracy Space Station#Tactical Actions|DSS Eagle Strike]] are unaffected and will perform Strafing Runs through the AA-Emplacements. If hit, the affected Eagle will immediately swerve up to safety to do more runs instead of having to leave.

== Trivia ==
* Completing the [[Compromise Automaton Defenses]] optional objective disables the effect of the {{PAGENAME}}. However, to truly complete this optional objective and get the rewards, Helldivers must destroy the {{PAGENAME}}s.

Mortar Emplacement.text: {{Infobox Mission | image_optional = {{PAGENAME}} TO Icon.svg | faction_optional = Automaton | min_difficulty_optional = 4 | max_difficulty_optional = 10 }} {{Infobox Structure |image = Bombard.png |faction = Automatons |min_difficulty = {{Difficulty|4}} |health = 400 }} {{Quote||Galactic War Terminal Description}} The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an [[Optional Objectives|Optional Objective]] contained within an [[Automatons|Automaton]] outpost. It attempts to shoot at enemy targets within range. To complete the Objective, Helldivers must destroy the {{PAGENAME}}s. It can spawn with [[Automaton Fabricator|Automaton Fabricators]], ammo, and [[Samples]] around it. == Objective Steps == * Destroy Automaton Mortar Emplacement. ** Helldivers are permitted to call down a [[NUX-223 Hellbomb]] to destroy the Mortar Emplacements. ** Alternatively any [[Weapon]] with {{Armor|3|AP}} penetration or above are able to destroy the vents of the emplacements while any {{Armor|4|AP}} penetrative weaponry or [[Stratagems]] can destroy the {{PAGENAME}} to any part of the defense. * Reward: {{Currency|Requisition|200}} & {{Currency|Experience|50}}. == Anatomy == {{Anatomy Table| {{Anatomy Row | part_name = Main | health = 400 | av = 4 | front_image = Mortar Emplacement Front.png | side_image = Mortar Emplacement Side.png | rear_image = Mortar Emplacement Rear.png | durability = 100% | percent_to_main = - | bleed = None | fatal = Yes | exdr = 0% }} {{Anatomy Row | part_name = Heatsink | health = 400 | av = 3 | rear_image = Mortar Emplacement Vent Rear.png | side_image = Mortar Emplacement Vent Side.png | durability = 100% | percent_to_main = 100% | dmg_cap_main = Yes | bleed = None | fatal = Yes | exdr = 0% }} }} == Weapons Loadout == {{Enemy Loadout Box | many = true | title = Heavy Bombard | file = Mortar Emplacement Bombard.png | description = Utilising an integrated automatic loader, the HE Shells loaded into the Heavy Bombard are amongst the largest ordinance used by the Automatons and are capable of creating a huge blast radius where they land, destroying anything caught within. | damage = {{Damage|20 Ballistic Damage}} | damage durable = {{Damage|2 Durable Damage}} | aoe_damage = {{Damage|Explosion|200 Blast Damage|notext}} | aoe_inner = 1.2m | aoe_outer = 6m | aoe_shockwave = 8m | aoe_ap = 4/3/4 | ap = 0/0/0/0 | rof = 8RPM / 7.5s (Sustained) | spread = ↔[250.00] ↕[220.00] | demo = 10 (Warhead), 30 (Blast) | stagger = 30 (Warhead), 50 (Blast) (Both Ragdoll) | push = 10 (Warhead), 40 (Blast) | extra = Write anything extra here }} == Tactical Information == *The {{PAGENAME}} will only fire at enemy targets if they have been spotted by other automatons ** Additionally a {{PAGENAME}} will only fire on those targets within 150m to 50m. * When a {{PAGENAME}} is firing at you, [[Mission Control]] will warn you with a voiceline: "Warning: you are in range of enemy artillery!" * The mortar shells comes with bright red trails when traveling in the air. Players can look to the sky to determine the direction and location of the {{PAGENAME}}. * The majority of the mortar emplacement is covered in {{Armor|4|AV}} armor, while having {{Armor|3|AV}} weakspots on the back, therefore any {{Armor|4|AP}} armor-penetrating weapon such as the [[AC-8 Autocannon]] and [[LAS-98 Laser Cannon]] can destroy them from range at any angle without having to call down a [[NUX-223 Hellbomb]]. ** Any anti-tank weapon can 1-shot the emplacements. ** The [[RS-422 Railgun]] requires an 80% charge shot to destroy. ** The [[PLAS-45 Epoch]] requires a fully-charged shot. * Weapons with {{Armor|3|AV}} penetration can still kill a {{PAGENAME}} from range. However, because this can only damage them from the back, the Helldiver will have to circle around to the correct position. This is most easily performed when the {{PAGENAME}} is shooting at a teammate, as every emplacement will be facing in the same direction without turning erratically. ** Weapons that only have {{Armor|4|AV}} penetration should also try to target the weakspots as they inflict their full damage on them leading to a far quicker kill with less ammo expended. This is especially true for weapons that have shrapnel, as shrapnel has {{Armor|3|AV}} penetration, often leading to a 1-shot. *Damaging [[Grenade|Grenades]] that have {{Armor|4|AV}} or above can destroy {{PAGENAME}}. ** [[Thermite]] can 1-shot {{PAGENAME}} if it sticks to it ** Both [[G-12 High Explosive]] and [[TED-63 Dynamite]] can also 1-shot {{PAGENAME}} but requires them to detonate very close to the structure, typically by cooking the grenade and throwing it so it explodes in the air. * {{PAGENAME}}s can also be destroyed by any of the offensive [[Stratagems]], [[Emplacement Stratagems]], as well as the [[MD-17 Anti-Tank Mines]] if using handheld weapons aren't a viable option or to save ammo. ==Trivia== *Completing the [[Compromise Automaton Defenses]] optional objective disables the {{PAGENAME}}, preventing them from firing. However, to truly complete this optional objective and get the rewards, Helldivers must destroy the {{PAGENAME}}s. *Following the release of [[1.007.100|Devoid of Liberty 7.1.0]], the {{PAGENAME}} was added to one of the layout of the [[Secondary Extraction Zone]]. == Gallery == Mortar emplacement.PNG|The Objective in game == Change History == {{Change History Head}} {{Change History Update|1.006.300|changes= Undocumented Changes * Projectile standard damage increased from 0 to 20 * Projectile durable damage increased from 0 to 2 * Projectile armor penetration decreased ** Direct Angle armor penetration decreased from {{Armor|4|AP}} to {{Armor|0|AP}} ** Slight Angle armor penetration decreased from {{Armor|4|AP}} to {{Armor|0|AP}} ** Large Angle armor penetration decreased from {{Armor|4|AP}} to {{Armor|0|AP}} ** Extreme Angle armor penetration decreased from {{Armor|4|AP}} to {{Armor|0|AP}} * Explosion armor penetration increased from {{Armor|3|AP}} to {{Armor|4|AP}} }} {{Change History Update|1.006.001|changes= Undocumented Changes * Projectile standard damage reduced from 20 to 0 * Projectile durable damage reduced from 2 to 0 * Projectile armor penetration increased ** Direct Angle armor penetration increased from {{Armor|0|AP}} to {{Armor|4|AP}} ** Slight Angle armor penetration increased from {{Armor|0|AP}} to {{Armor|4|AP}} ** Large Angle armor penetration increased from {{Armor|0|AP}} to {{Armor|4|AP}} ** Extreme Angle armor penetration increasedfrom {{Armor|0|AP}} to {{Armor|4|AP}} }} {{Change History Update|1.005.000|changes= Change * Added a {{Armor|3|AV}} armored weakspot to the vents on the backside of the Mortar Emplacement. }} [[Category:Automatons]] [[Category:Missions]] [[Category:Optional Objectives]] {{Nav Enemy}} {{Nav Objective}} __FORCETOC__

Sabotage Air Base.title: Sabotage Air Base
Sabotage Air Base.text:
{{Infobox Mission | title = {{PAGENAME}} | image_main = Sabotage Air Base Mission Icon.svg | time_limit_main = 40 Minutes | faction_main = Automaton | min_difficulty_main = 3 | max_difficulty_main = 10 }} {{Infobox Structure | title = Parked Dropship | image = Automaton Parked Dropship.png | faction = Automatons | class = | health = 1,000 | min_difficulty = {{difficulty|3}} | max_difficulty = {{difficulty|10}} }} |-|Standard= {{Quote|A large Automaton air base in this region is conducting frequent troop deployments by Dropship---a tactical advantage we cannot allow.

Deploy behind enemy lines and destroy their Dropships and the air base's infrastructure.|Mission Briefing}} |-|City mission= {{Quote|The Automatons have constructed an air base where our citizens' homes once stood, allowing them to dominate the city's airspace.

Breach the base and raze it to the ground. Don't leave a single Dropship standing.|Mission Briefing, city mission}} |-|Automaton Megafactory= {{Quote|The Cyborgs dictate the surrounding air domain from this fortified air base. It must be decisively obliterated.

Infiltrate the base and tear it down. Destroy any grounded Dropships in sight.|Megafactory Mission Briefing, Cyberstan Mission}} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a Mission that can appear on Automaton-controlled planets. It tasks Helldivers with destroying one or more parked Dropships and, on {{Difficulty|5}} and above, destroying an Air Base Control Tower. This is reflected in the Mission’s icon, overriding the Dropship icon if the Air Base Control Tower is present. Starting at {{Difficulty|7}}, Helldivers are required to destroy two Air Base Control Towers and one group of Dropships, on {{Difficulty|9}}, this is increased to two air bases and two groups of Dropships. * However, this does not apply to [[Biomes|City]] missions. In Cities, {{Difficulty|7}} and above will require one Air Base Control Tower and two groups of Dropships to be destroyed. == Mission Walkthrough == === Destroy Air Base Control Tower === |-|Standard= {{Quote|All Dropship communication is routed through this Control Tower. Destroying it will disable any long range dropship deployments.|Objective Overview}} |-|Automaton Megafactory= {{Quote|This Control Tower is the nexus of enemy aerial operations in the region.|Megafactory objective Overview, Cyberstan mission}} * Locate and unlock system access port ** Helldivers must find and interact with a SSSD container found inside the base * Use Stratagem: [[SSSD Delivery]] ** Helldivers must call down the SSSD by inputting: {{Stratagem_code|down|down|down|down|down|up|up}} * Collect the SSSD Hard Drive * Insert SSSD into receptacle ** The receptacle can either be found next to the terminal present in the air base, or next to the Air Base Control Tower itself. * Hack into the terminal to sabotage Control Tower ** Helldivers must find and interact with the terminal found inside the base * Bypass terminal security ** Helldivers are presented with a puzzle, requiring them to match Automaton letters into the correct order, shown by the key on the right side of the terminal. [[File:Compromise Automaton Defenses OO Terminal.png|400px]] * Use terminal to sabotage Control Tower ** Helldivers are required to activate three different switches, similar to a [[SEAF SAM Site]] * Use terminal to complete sabotage ** Helldivers are required to press a single switch, doing so will start a 10 second countdown after which the Air Base Control Tower will explode and the objective will be completed. ** The explosion is similar to that of a [[NUX-223 Hellbomb]], so Helldivers are advised to stay away from the Air Base Control Tower during the countdown sequence. === Destroy Dropships === |-|Standard= {{Quote|An Automaton Air Base is located in this region. Dropships are undergoing maintenance at this facility, leaving them vulnerable.|Objective Overview}} |-|Automaton Megafactory= {{Quote|Automaton Dropships are docked at this location.|Megafactory objective Overview, Cyberstan mission}} * Destroy Automaton Dropships ** Helldivers are required to use any means necessary to destroy all Dropships present. == Parked Dropship Stats == {{Anatomy Table| {{Anatomy Row | part_name = Main | health = 1,000 | av = 5 | front_image = Parked Dropship Front.png | side_image = Parked Dropship Side.png | rear_image = Parked Dropship Rear.png | durability = 100% | percent_to_main = - | bleed = None | fatal = Yes | exdr = 0% }} }} == Tactical Information == * The Dropships in the "Destroy Dropships" objective are not the same as their flying counterparts as they have significantly less health at 1,000 vs 3,500, and the thrusters are not separate parts of the fuselage. * [[Eagle]] [[stratagems]] such as the [[Eagle 500kg Bomb]], [[Eagle Airstrike]], and [[Eagle Strafing Run]] can destroy multiple dropships. * Any Weapon/Stratagem with {{Armor|5|AP}} armor penetration, preferably with high durable damage such as the [[PLAS-45 Epoch]] or [[LAS-99 Quasar Cannon]], can destroy the grounded Dropships. ** 1 shot with any Anti-Tank. ** 1 shot from the [[GP-20 Ultimatum]] or 2 from the [[P-33 Missile Pistol]] ** 1 [[G-123 Thermite]] or [[G-48 Giga Grenade]], or 2 [[TM-1 Lure Mine]] ** 2 fully-charged shots with the [[PLAS-45 Epoch]]. ** 3-4 99% charged shots with the [[RS-422 Railgun]]. * Conventional attacks cannot destroy the Air Base Control Tower. You must call down the objective equipment, insert it, and engage the terminal to self-destruct the tower. == Trivia == * The following text appears for the switches while operating the Air Base Control Tower-panel ** Critical System Interface: Pressure, Temperature, Electrical ** Sabotage Software: Confirm == Maps At Each Difficulty == Sabotage Air Base Description Medium.png|Medium Difficulty Sabotage Air Base Description Challenging.png|Challenging Difficulty Sabotage Air Base Description Hard.png|Hard Difficulty Sabotage Air Base Description Extreme.png|Extreme Difficulty (City) == Gallery == Automaton Airbase Tower.png|Air Base Control Tower Automaton Airbase Tower Hacked.png|Hacked Air Base Control Tower == Change History == {{Change History Head}} {{Change History Halt Cyborg Production.title: Halt Cyborg Production
Halt Cyborg Production.text:
{{Infobox Mission | title = {{PAGENAME}} | image_main = {{PAGENAME}} Mission Icon.svg | time_limit_main = 40 Minutes | faction_main = Automaton | min_difficulty_main = 4 | max_difficulty_main = 10 }} {{Quote|Production of new Cyborg requires a bio-synthetic process conducted in massive production units. They are structurally blastproof, but can be destroyed from within by exploiting the volatile hydrogen fuel used in the process.

Flood the Production Unit with hydrogen, then destabilize its integrity until it fails safe and self-destructs.|Megafactory Mission Briefing, Cyberstan Mission}} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an [[Automatons|Automaton]] [[Main Objectives|Main Objective]] in ''[[Helldivers 2]]''. This is a [[Megafactory]] only objective, in which Helldivers are tasked with destroying a [[Cyborg Legion|Cyborg]] Production Unit by flooding, and detonating it with Hydrogen. == Objective Steps == ==== Flood Hydrogen Pipeline ==== {{Quote|A fuel station in this district powers the Cyborg Production Unit with highly combustible hydrogen.|Mission Map Description}} * Adjust all the valves to maximize hydrogen flow ** There are 2 to 3 valves in each mission area ** Interact with each valve and rotate it until the pressure gauge needle hits the red zone ** Hydrogen pipes, when overloaded, will become hazards that set Helldivers on {{Damage|Fire}} ==== Destroy Cooling Tower ==== {{Quote|A mechanical chiller at this location cools the hydrogen that flows into the Cyborg Production Unit.|Mission Map Description}} * Call down a hellbomb to destroy the Cooling Tower ** There are 1 to 2 cooling towers in the mission area === Demolish Cyborg Assembly Unit === {{Quote|Inside this towering facility, Cyborgs are grown in pod-like artificial wombs.|Mission Map Description}} * Bypass terminal security * Use terminal to direct hydrogen into Power Core * Tighten all exhaust pipe clamps * Use terminal to unlock Control Chamber * Adjust valves in Control Chamber to overload engine * Return to terminal and force-start unit * Rapidly clear the area * The currently known bug is that when using the teleport pack to actively interrupt the destruction of the main target during the final milliseconds of the animation, the valve-closing process may cause the mission objective to fail to activate properly, rendering the mission impossible to complete. == Tactical Information == * The Cooling Tower requires a demolition force of 50 to destroy, which means it can be destroyed through means other than a [[NUX-223 Hellbomb]]: ** A [[B-100 Portable Hellbomb]]. ** A [[Eagle 500kg Bomb]]. ** [[Orbital 120mm HE Barrage|Orbital 120mm]], [[Orbital 380mm HE Barrage|Orbital 380mm]], [[Orbital Precision Strike]], [[Orbital Walking Barrage]], [[Orbital Gas Strike]], [[Orbital EMS Strike]], or the [[Orbital Smoke Strike]] *** The last three requires a ''direct'' hit. * The Cyborg Production tower produces an ''immensely'' large explosion 30 seconds after the final step to initiate destruction. It is recommended to begin running away as soon as the demolition process begins to survive the shockwave. * Make sure the area is clear before entering the Cyborg Production Facility's doors to overload the hydrogen; there is only one way out, and it is easy to be surrounded. == Maps At Each Difficulty == Halt Cyborg Production Description Challenging.png|Challenging Difficulty Halt Cyborg Production Description Hard.png|Hard Difficulty Halt Cyborg Production Description Extreme.png|Extreme Difficulty Halt Cyborg Production Description Suicide Mission.png|Suicide Mission Difficulty Halt Cyborg Production Description Impossible.png|Impossible Difficulty Halt Cyborg Production Description Helldive.png|Helldive Difficulty Halt Cyborg Production Description Super Helldive.png|Super Helldive Difficulty == Trivia == * Unlike other multi-step objective missions, which have set number per mission, the sub-objectives for {{PAGENAME}} can vary between the two. ** Destroy Cooling Tower or Flood Hydrogen Pipes can appear once, twice, or none at all. (must have 2-3 sub-objectives in total, depending on difficulty) * Despite High Command's claim that the main objective is for producing Cyborgs, the overall system seems to be akin to [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cryonics cryonics], and the deep-freeze storage of Cyborgs. ** Although evidence is limited, the idea originates from the large amounts of Hydrogen being funneled into the system, and seeing the freezing vapor emerge from the internal Cyborg Pods. {{clear}} == Gallery == Halt Cyborg Production Fuel Station.png|The fuel station Halt Cyborg Production Cooling Tower.png|The cooling tower Halt Cyborg Production Cyborg Assembly Unit.png|The Cyborg Assembly Unit == Change History == {{Change History Head}} {{Change History Update|1.006.100|changes= Fix * Fixed a bug where Levers on Cyborg Assembly unit would not work if you were killed/ragdolled while interacting with them. }} {{Change History Update|1.006.003|date=2026-02-10|changes= Addition * Added to the game. }} [[Category:Automatons]] [[Category:Missions]] [[Category:Main Objectives]] {{Nav Objective}} __FORCETOC__

Gazer.title: Gazer
Gazer.text:
{{Infobox Structure | title = {{PAGENAME}} | image = Gazer_Enemy_Icon_Render.png | image_caption = | faction = Illuminate | damage = {{Damage|Laser|50 DPS Gazer Burner|notext}}
+{{Damage|Fire|100/s (3s) Burn|notext}} | damage_type = {{Damage|Laser}} | min_difficulty = {{Difficulty|1}} }} The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' are Illuminate defenses found at Illuminate structures. == Spawning == Gazer can sometimes be found at [[Illuminate Encampment]]s and Illuminate exclusive [[Missions#Illuminate Specific|Objectives]] in Megacities and Illuminate ruins. == Behavior == Gazer scans the area around them and locks onto hostile targets before firing a beam at them. Helldivers can avoid this beam by taking note of their tracking laser as it begins to visibly charge up. Although Gazer fires a beam visually similar to Harvester lasers, they do very low damage per second, and it is relatively safe to run through one momentarily, although it will set the Helldiver on fire. At shorter ranges, Gazers cannot rotate fast enough to track Helldivers. Gazer can be quickly destroyed with any small arms fire directly to their eye weak-spot, but the areas surrounding the eye are protected {{Armor|5|AV}} armor. == Anatomy == {{Anatomy Table| {{Anatomy Row | part_name = Main | health = 900 | av = 5 | front_image = Gazer Main.png | durability = 100% | percent_to_main = - | dmg_cap_main =- | bleed = None | fatal = Yes | exdr = 0% | df=20 }} {{Anatomy Row | part_name = Eye | health = 700 | av = 1 | front_image = Gazer Eye.png | durability = 0% | percent_to_main = 100% | dmg_cap_main = Yes | bleed = None | fatal = Yes | exdr = 0% | df=20 }} {{Anatomy Row | part_name = Sphere | health = 900 | av = 5 | front_image = Gazer Sphere.png | durability = 0% | percent_to_main = 100% | dmg_cap_main = Yes | bleed = None | fatal = Yes | exdr = 0% | df = 20 }} {{Anatomy Row | part_name = Base | health = 900 | av = 5 | front_image = Gazer Base.png | durability = 0% | percent_to_main = 100% | dmg_cap_main = Yes | bleed = None | fatal = Yes | exdr = 100% | df=20 }} | df = yes }} == Weapons Loadout ==

== Tactical Information == * The Gazer can easily be outmaneuvered by running to the side, and in some cases, easily ignored altogether. * Gazer can be destroyed by weapons with a [[Demolition]] force of '''20''' or higher. Examples include the [[APW-1 Anti-Materiel Rifle]], the [[G-6 Frag]] grenade or [[LAS-98 Laser Cannon]]. * The eye of the Gazer only has {{Armor|1|AV}} armor with 0% durability and is therefore vulnerable to any weapon. Aim at the eye, and you should destroy it with ease. Beware of the beam when engaging with this method. == Appearance == File:Illuminate Gazer.png|An Illuminate Gazer == Trivia == * The Gazer bears a striking resemblance to the [https://liquipedia.net/starcraft2/Photon_Cannon_%28Legacy_of_the_Void%29 Protoss Photon Cannon] from ''Starcraft II: Legacy of the Void'', both being a stationary turret in the form of a floating, eye-like orb. == Change History == {{Change History Head}} {{Change History Update|1.006.001|changes= Undocumented Change * Gazer Burner durable damage DPS increased from 25 DPS to 75 DPS }} {{Change History Update|1.003.200|changes= Undocumented Addition * Added to the game. }} {{Enemy2List}} [[Category:Illuminate]] [[Category:Enemies]] __FORCETOC__

== Tactical Information == * The '''Gazer Spire''' requires a demolition force of '''60''', which means it can '''only''' be destroyed with a [[B-100 Portable Hellbomb]], [[NUX-223 Hellbomb]], or a [[SEAF Artillery|SEAF Artillery: Mini-Nuke]]. ** Despite sharing an AP value, the [[MS-11 Solo Silo]] cannot destroy the Gazer Spire, as the Solo Silo lacks the required demo force as well as being immune to explosive damage. It is not the explosive damage of a Hellbomb that destroys the Gazer Spire, but rather the demo force from the explosion. * The Gazer Spire has a range of roughly '''250 m''' . When it spots a Helldiver, it will begins to visibly charge up before firing its laser. Evasive action is recommended, as the beam is highly lethal. ** Vehicles, especially [[Exosuit (disambiguation)|Exosuits,]] are very vulnerable due to the beam's long range and high damage output. ** Similar to the [[Gazer]], the Gazer Spire's beam can easily be outmaneuvered on foot by walking to the side or taking cover. * [[Warp Gateway|Warp Gateways]] are constructed around the '''Gazer Spire's''' structure, which will constantly spawn enemy units unless destroyed. == Gallery == File:Illuminate Gazer Spire Charging.png|Gazer Spire charging File:Illuminate Gazer Spire Firing.png|Gazer Spire's beam == Change History == {{Change History Head}} {{Change History Update|1.007.100|changes= Fix * The Gazer Spire will no longer stop firing when a target dies and will instead complete its whole firing cycle. }} {{Change History Update|1.007.000|changes= Addition * Added to the game. }} {{Nav Enemy}} [[Category:Illuminate]] [[Category:Enemies]] __FORCETOC__

These will continuously teleport new Illuminate units until the structure is destroyed. == Anatomy == {{Anatomy Table| {{Anatomy Row | part_name = Main | health = 1,500 | av = 5 | front_image = | side_image = | durability = 100% | percent_to_main = - | bleed = None | fatal = Yes | exdr = 0% | df=40 }} {{Anatomy Row | part_name = Gateway | health = - | front_image = | durability = N/A | percent_to_main = - | bleed = None | fatal = Yes | exdr = 0% | df=20 if {{Damage|Explosion||notext}} }} |df=yes}} == Tactical Information == * Warp Gateways can be destroyed in two ways: ** Damaging the inside of the Gateway when the inner mechanism is exposed, requiring an '''explosive demo force of 20'''. *** The center aperture of the Gateway will periodically open to spawn new Illuminate units, providing a chance for a weapon such as a [[Grenade]] to be thrown inside. ** Destroying the Gateway from the outside with a weapon or stratagem capable of a '''demo force of 40''', or penetrating its {{Armor|5|AV}} armor to deplete the structure's health. *When destroyed, the {{PAGENAME}}s will explode after several seconds; this explosion has enough stagger force to ragroll a Helldiver. As such, it is highly advised to run away immediately after destroying a {{PAGENAME}}. == Gallery == Illuminate Warp Gateway Closed.png|Inactive Warp Gateway Illuminate Warp Gateway Exploding.png|Warp Gateway about to explode == Change History == {{Change History Head}} {{Change History Update|1.007.000|date=26-08-14|changes= Addition * Added to the game. }} [[Category:Illuminate]] {{Nav Enemy}}
